# Handoff

## Overview

Turns a feature request into testable requirements.

## When to use

Before planning. Not for ordering tasks: that belongs to plan.

## Process

1. Ask what done means. It's working if each answer is a testable sentence.
2. Write the requirements. It's working if each has an id.

## Rationalizations

| Excuse | Reality |
|---|---|
| "The ask is clear" | Clear asks still hide edge cases. |

## Red flags

- Requirements without ids.

## Verification

- Every requirement has an id and a test idea.
